dedupe_keys.name: distribution transformers of cauca department colombia 16 000 transformers with power burn rate users and unsupplied electricity 2019 and 2020

description: A Mendeley Data dataset describing electric power distribution transformers in the Cauca Department of Colombia. Contents: about 16,000 distribution transformers across rural and urban areas of 42 municipalities, for the years 2019 and 2020, held in two Excel workbooks (one per year). The description lists six categorical variables (location, self-protected, removable connector, criticality according to ceraunic level, client type and installation type) and five continuous ones (transformer power, burn rate, number of users, unsupplied electricity and secondary line length). Producer: Diego A. Bravo M., Carlos Lozano and Laura Alvarez, with an affiliation to Universidad del Valle recorded for two of them. Coverage: Cauca Department, Colombia. Format and access: XLSX files of 1.2 MB each, downloadable from Mendeley Data (DOI 10.17632/yzyj46xpmy.4, version 4 published 17 September 2021). Free. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: no coordinates are named in the description, so mapping needs the location variable; the operator supplying the data is not stated on the dataset page. Simulation uses: transformer failure, reliability and outage impact models for distribution networks. Related records: none identified.
